[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Dirk Balor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who commanded an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dirk Balor's Star Destroyer|battle cruiser]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Balor's ship carried [[Reist]], an example of an extremely rare creature known as a [[nightmare demon]], whose [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] abilities made it a significant threat to those around it&mdash;Balor employed a [[Human replica droid]] called [[Altin Wuho]] to keep the nightmare demon under control and allow it to be focused against Balor's enemies. [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Balor encountered [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the remote [[Lapez system/Legends|Lapez system]], and dispatched Reist and Wuho to slay the man. However, Reist and Wuho [[Death/Legends|died]] in the encounter, and Skywalker managed to slip away.<ref name="masque" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dirk Balor appeared in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 149|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 149: Death Masque'']], written by [[Steve Moore]] and released in [[1981]].<ref name="masque" />
